item.title: Megadeth Celebrates 40 Years of 'Killing Is My Business' With Limited Box Set
item.description: Megadeth is marking the 40th anniversary of its debut album with a special box set release. Titled Killing Is My Business… And Business Is Good!, the ultra-limited collection arrives October 17 and will be restricted to just 350 copies.

item.title: AC/DC Opens European Tour in Prague, Czech President Attends; VIDEOS
item.description: AC/DC launched the summer leg of their “Power Up” European tour Thursday night in Prague, Czech Republic. The concert took place at Letiště Praha Letňany and drew an estimated crowd of 60,000 people.

item.title: KORN’s Full PINKPOP 2007 Performance With SLIPKNOT’s JOEY JORDISON Released On YouTube
item.description: A professionally filmed video of KORN’s full set at the Pinkpop Festival in the Netherlands — recorded on May 28, 2007 — has been made available online via the Pinkpop Archive YouTube channel.

item.title: WOLFGANG VAN HALEN Explains Why He Backed Out of OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final Concert: 'I Wouldn’t Be Able To Pull It Off'
item.description: Wolfgang Van Halen, son of late guitar legend Eddie Van Halen, was originally scheduled to appear at Ozzy Osbourne’s farewell concert, Back to the Beginning, on July 5 in Birmingham, U.

item.title: Why IRON MAIDEN Turned To Japan Before Chasing The American Dream, According to ROD SMALLWOOD
item.description: Iron Maiden’s first real step onto the global stage came in 1981, the same year the band dropped Killers and hit the road for their first world tour.

item.title: Ex-Mastodon BRENT HINDS Slams Former Bandmates In Exit Statement: 'A S**t Band With Horrible Humans'
item.description: Brent Hinds, the former guitarist and vocalist of Mastodon, didn’t exactly offer a warm farewell. In a blunt comment on Instagram, he referred to the group as a “s**t band with horrible humans.

item.title: SCORPIONS/Ex-MOTÖRHEAD MIKKEY DEE Admits He Felt Lost Playing With KING DIAMOND: 'I Was A Lousy Drummer'
item.description: Mikkey Dee, born Micael Kiriakos Delaoglou in Gothenburg, Sweden, got his big break playing drums for King Diamond. But in a recent interview with Rock Kommander (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.

item.title: VENOM INC.'s TONY DOLAN Reacts To Public Accusations From MANTAS: 'They All Blame Me For Their Own Demise'
item.description: Tony Dolan is setting the record straight. The bassist and vocalist of VENOM INC. recently addressed his fallout with guitarist Jeff “Mantas” Dunn, who officially left the band in late 2023.

item.title: Watch FEMME FATALE's New Video for 'Living Like There's No Tomorrow'
item.description: Femme Fatale, the rock band led by Lorraine Lewis, has returned with a new song called “Living Like There’s No Tomorrow” (watch it below). The track is now available through Cleopatra Records, and its official music video, directed by Vicente Cordero, is out now.

item.title: When MAX CAVALERA Almost Reunited With SEPULTURA: 'We'll Cross Paths Again'
item.description: Max Cavalera is best known for helping create one of Brazil’s most influential metal bands: Sepultura. But in 1996, after years of success, he walked away from it all.

item.title: AARON STAINTHORPE Talks Leaving MY DYING BRIDE: 'I Feel 10 Years Younger'
item.description: Aaron Stainthorpe, known for fronting British metal band My Dying Bride for over three decades, says his new project has given him a fresh perspective, and a second wind.

item.title: Dave 'PHOENIX' Farrell Talks LINKIN PARK’s Return: 'Time Doesn’t Heal The Wound, It Changes The Lens'
item.description: Linkin Park is back on tour with a new album and new members. But for bassist Dave “Phoenix” Farrell, returning to the band after Chester Bennington’s death was not easy.

item.title: AC/DC Announces 2025 Stadium Tour of Australia With Amyl and The Sniffers
item.description: AC/DC is heading back to their roots. The legendary Australian rock band has announced a five-city stadium tour across the country for November and December 2025. This will be their first Australian tour in ten years.

item.title: The AC/DC album that FLOPPED HARDER Than Expected And Nearly Turned Into A FULL-BLOWN CRISIS
item.description: Back in Black is the album everyone knows. It’s the one that sold like crazy and turned AC/DC into a global powerhouse. But not every album had the same luck.

item.title: Dave 'PHOENIX' Farrell Breaks Silence on CHESTER BENNINGTON’s Death: 'Is It Even Called LINKIN PARK Anymore?'
item.description: Linkin Park bassist Dave “Phoenix” Farrell opened up about the band’s long road back to music after the loss of lead singer Chester Bennington. In a new interview with Czech station Evropa 2 (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.

item.title: ASKING ALEXANDRIA Fans Question Danny Worsnop’s Performance, Call for His Exit
item.description: Asking Alexandria’s recent Warped Tour performance is stirring debate online, and some fans think it may be time for lead singer Danny Worsnop to step aside. The band’s subreddit lit up after their June 15 set, with over a dozen posts and hundreds of comments discussing Worsnop’s vocals and stage presence.

item.title: Ex-EXODUS RICK HUNOLT Looks Back On Thrash Origins: 'We Inspired METALLICA And SLAYER'
item.description: Ex-EXODUS guitarist Rick Hunolt didn’t bother dancing around it during a recent chat with Pod Scum host Rexx Ruger (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.NET). When Ruger put Hunolt and Gary Holt on the same tier as Hetfield/Hammett or Hanneman/King, Hunolt didn’t blink.

item.title: LINKIN PARK Cancels Switzerland Concert After Health Problem in Band: 'We’re Not In A Spot To Perform Tonight'
item.description: Linkin Park called off their performance in Bern, Switzerland just hours before showtime, citing a medical issue within the band. The June 20 concert at Bernexpo was part of the group’s 2025 world tour promoting From Zero, their first album since 2017.

item.title: THREE DAYS GRACE Releases New Single 'DOMINATE' Ahead Of Upcoming Album
item.description: Three Days Grace has released a new single titled “Dominate” (watch the video at the end of the article), available today on all major streaming platforms. The track is part of the band’s upcoming eighth studio album, Alienation, scheduled for release on August 22, 2025, via RCA Records.

item.title: STEVE DIGIORGIO On Recording With DAVE MUSTAINE: 'He Wasn't What I Expected'
item.description: Steve DiGiorgio, longtime bassist for Testament, has spoken candidly about his brief but intense experience recording with Dave Mustaine for Megadeth’s album The Sick, The Dying… And The Dead!

item.title: AMY LEE Talks About EMMA ANZAI Joining EVANESCENCE: 'I Called Her First'
item.description: Evanescence frontwoman Amy Lee has opened up about the band’s evolving lineup and her longtime connection with bassist Emma Anzai, offering rare insight into the decision-making behind the group’s most recent personnel shift.

item.title: Ex-Pantera TERRY GLAZE On DIMEBAG's Death: 'It Didn't Hit Me Until I Saw The Dirt'
item.description: Former Pantera vocalist Terry Glaze has shared a personal account of how he learned about the death of guitarist “Dimebag” Darrell Abbott and the emotional aftermath that followed.

item.title: RINGO STARR Slams ROGER DALTREY Over Firing Of Son: 'Never Liked How That Little Man Runs The Band'
item.description: Zak Starkey didn’t bother hiding his disappointment after being pushed out of The Who, a gig he held for nearly 30 years as the band’s live drummer. It all unraveled after a messy show at the Royal Albert Hall earlier this year, which ultimately triggered the official announcement of his departure in April.

item.title: IRON MAIDEN Fans Slam 50th Anniversary Tour: 'Most Predictable Setlist Possible'
item.description: Iron Maiden launched their Run for Your Lives 50th anniversary tour on May 27 in Budapest, Hungary. Grab Your Tickets Here. The show introduced Simon Dawson behind the drums, stepping in after Nicko McBrain retired in late 2024.

item.title: PIGGY D. On Working With MARILYN MANSON: 'I'm Proud To Stand Next To Him'
item.description: Matt Montgomery, better known as Piggy D., isn’t shy when it comes to describing his experience playing bass for Marilyn Manson. In a recent interview with Radioactive MikeZ on 96.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE starts recording vocals as MEGADETH’s 17th studio album nears completion
item.description: The next Megadeth record has been crawling toward completion for months. Since the release of The Sick, The Dying… and the Dead! back in 2022, work on its successor has quietly advanced.

item.title: DAVID VINCENT Reflects On Fan Expectations: 'Nobody Cares About The New Stuff'
item.description: David Vincent, the former Morbid Angel frontman, isn’t exactly rushing to crank out new material with I Am Morbid. In a recent sit-down with Altars Of Metal, the inevitable question popped up: will I Am Morbid ever release original songs?

item.title: David Ellefson: "I Miss Dave" But I’m Done With Megadeth’s Drama
item.description: David Ellefson still feels the absence of Dave Mustaine in his life, even after everything. In a recent chat with The Delz Show, Ellefson reflected: “I miss Dave too.

item.title: OnlyFans and Rock: Lorraine Lewis, The FEMME FATALE singer, embraces her wild side with new content
item.description: Lorraine Lewis isn’t just standing still. She’s moving, shaking things up, and dragging rock and roll with her (kicking and screaming, probably). You remember her, right? The voice behind FEMME FATALE.

item.title: Linkin Park’s Mike Shinoda Talks Brad Delson’s Tour Absence
item.description: Linkin Park’s reunion, complete with a fresh album release last Friday, has been making waves. Yet, the band’s current lineup feels like a revolving door. With Chester Bennington’s tragic loss in 2017 and drummer Rob Bourdon sitting this one out, it’s already a scaled-back return.

item.title: Mike Shinoda on Why Brad Delson Isn’t Touring With Linkin Park
item.description: Brad Delson, the longtime six-string maestro of Linkin Park, is still very much part of the band. In the studio, behind the scenes—he’s there, making things happen. But if you were hoping to see him shred live, prepare for disappointment.

item.title: Tim Lambesis Faces Solo Challenge as As I Lay Dying Joins Rockville 2025
item.description: The lineup for Welcome to Rockville 2025 has been rolling out steadily, but one name caught more than a few raised eyebrows this weekend—As I Lay Dying. For those not keeping score, the band is now essentially just Tim Lambesis.

item.title: Welcome to Rockville 2025 Books As I Lay Dying Despite Chaos
item.description: The wreckage that is 2024 As I Lay Dying looks more like a construction zone than a band these days, but apparently, that’s not stopping Tim Lambesis from slapping the name on a festival poster.

item.title: Tim Lambesis to Continue As I Lay Dying After Major Band Departures
item.description: Tim Lambesis seems hell-bent on keeping As I Lay Dying alive, despite the complete meltdown the band’s endured recently. Over the past few weeks, total chaos erupted as band members exited left and right without a word from Lambesis, until now.

item.title: Phil Sgrosso Joins Mass Departure from As I Lay Dying; See Details
item.description: Phil Sgrosso has left As I Lay Dying behind, joining the recent exodus from a band that now stands with only Tim Lambesis on board. After nearly two decades of dedication split across two stints—2003 to 2014, and again from 2018 to now—Sgrosso decided it was time to step back.

item.title: KEN SUSI Walks Away from AS I LAY DYING: "My Morals Hit Their Limit"
item.description: The As I Lay Dying ship seems to be taking on water—fast. First, bassist Ryan Neff jumped overboard, offering little more than a vague farewell. Then whispers started about their European tour vanishing into thin air, allegedly after their tour manager quit.

item.title: Drummer Nick Pierce Leaves As I Lay Dying Citing Health Concerns
item.description: As I Lay Dying seems to be unraveling faster than a cheap sweater at a metal merch stand. The band now consists of just Tim Lambesis and Phil Sgrosso, as drummer Nick Pierce becomes the latest member to exit stage left.

item.title: European Tour Canceled as As I Lay Dying Faces Major Member Departures
item.description: It’s a mass exodus over in the As I Lay Dying camp, with members dropping off faster than you can say “farewell tour.” The band’s entire European tour is scrapped, and not a peep has come from the remaining members—whoever’s still sticking around, that is.

item.title: Ryan Neff Exits As I Lay Dying: Another Chapter in the Band’s Soap Opera
item.description: Bassist and vocalist Ryan Neff decided his time with As I Lay Dying was short-lived, officially announcing his departure on October 18. The timing? Right before the band gears up for a sprawling European tour.

item.title: Ice Nine Kills Drummer Patrick Galante Steps Down
item.description: Ice Nine Kills just lost a piece of their rhythm section, and no, it’s not some dramatic ‘spooky’ horror movie twist. Patrick Galante, who’s been holding down the drum kit since 2018, has decided to hang up his sticks—at least with INK.

item.title: John 5 Breaks Silence on Relationship With Rob Zombie After Joining Mötley Crüe
item.description: John 5, the guy who’s jumped from Rob Zombie’s ship straight into the glam-coated arms of Mötley Crüe, apparently hasn’t had a real chat with Zombie since his departure.

item.title: Linkin Park's Mike Shinoda: "This Isn’t a Reunion, It’s a New Chapter"
item.description: Mike Shinoda recently shared more details about Linkin Park’s reformation during an interview with BBC Radio 1’s New Music Show With Jack Saunders. The vocalist and multi-instrumentalist pulled back the curtain on how the band’s new chapter began and what fans can expect moving forward.

item.title: Brad Delson Walks Away from Linkin Park’s Reunion—Here’s Why
item.description: Here we go again. Linkin Park just can’t stop throwing curveballs. First, it’s a new singer. Then, a new album. And, of course, the big reunion tour. But now?

item.title: Linkin Park Breaks Silence on Rob Bourdon’s Departure
item.description: If you haven’t already heard, Linkin Park is back. And no, this isn’t some watered-down reunion tour cash grab. The band has recruited Dead Sara’s Emily Armstrong as their new vocalist, with Colin Brittain stepping in on drums.

item.title: Linkin Park is Back with a New Album and Unexpected Vocalist
item.description: Leave it to Linkin Park to make their return a three-ring circus. A flashy new album, a shiny logo, and a brand-new vocalist, Emily Armstrong, were all unveiled during a livestream that pulled over 100,000 viewers on YouTube and an extra 26,000 on Instagram.

item.title: Is Lzzy Hale the Future Voice of Linkin Park? Fans Think So
item.description: Linkin Park has been pulling some real grade-A stunts lately. Countdowns leading to… more countdowns. Announcements that announce other announcements. It’s like watching a toddler try to explain a magic trick—it’s messy, pointless, and you’re not even mad, just confused.

item.title: Linkin Park Countdown Ends: What Does 'Be Part of Something' Mean?
item.description: It all started with that bizarre 100-hour countdown plastered across Linkin Park’s socials and website last week. For those who missed the memo, this wasn’t your standard “big announcement” fare—it was more like staring at a ticking clock and wondering if someone accidentally pressed the wrong button.

item.title: Sum 41's Deryck Whibley Responds to Linkin Park Frontman Rumors
item.description: Speculation on the rock and metal rumor mill has been churning at full speed this week. Thanks to some coinciding announcements, the internet collectively decided that Sum 41’s frontman, Deryck Whibley, might be stepping in as the new voice of Linkin Park, filling the irreplaceable shoes of the late Chester Bennington.

item.title: Corey Taylor on Why Slipknot Chose Eloy Casagrande as Their New Drummer
item.description: Slipknot’s decision to bring in Eloy Casagrande, formerly of Sepultura, as their new drummer has sparked plenty of chatter. Let’s be honest—watching his relentless, jaw-dropping drum videos circulating online, it’s hard to argue they didn’t find their guy.

item.title: AS I LAY DYING and Jordan Mancino Part Ways: Legal Drama and New Drummer Nick Pierce
item.description: Jordan Mancino, the drummer who had been with As I Lay Dying since the early days, seems to have permanently checked out. Not in a quiet, amicable way either—this one comes with lawyers, statements, and all the usual mess you’d expect when band relationships implode.

item.title: Evanescence's Amy Lee Responds to Linkin Park Vocalist Speculation
item.description: Amy Lee. Linkin Park. Together? (Ha, no.) But for a second, it almost felt real, didn’t it? All thanks to Jay Gordon (yes, from Orgy, of all people) who casually mentioned that Linkin Park might—might—be looking for a female vocalist.

item.title: Korn's Next Album in 2024 Could Be Their First Without Fieldy
item.description: Korn apparently has some new sounds brewing for 2024, if guitarist Brian “Head” Welch is to be believed. He recently mentioned on The Joe Kingdom Perspective that there’s “new music coming next year,” though it seems like the band is in some kind of self-imposed exile right now, as he put it, “just doing our own thing.

item.title: As I Lay Dying Recruits Nick Pierce as Drummer for Tour; See Details
item.description: Jordan Mancino, the drummer who’s been part of As I Lay Dying since the beginning, has decided to step away from the band’s upcoming Two Decades of Destruction Tour.

item.title: Jordan Mancino Steps Back: As I Lay Dying Faces Internal Challenges
item.description: The chaos surrounding As I Lay Dying just keeps piling up. After Josh Gilbert made his grand exit, the band scrambled to patch things together by roping in Ryan Neff of Miss May I to cover bass and vocals, while Ken Susi of Unearth stepped in on guitar.
